actions.label: Compare tray shortcut delivery with a control app

reproduce.title: Test remapped shortcut activation of Lossless Scaling from tray
prerequisites: Lossless Scaling installed and configured to minimize to tray.
A remapped shortcut matching the issue's source and destination.
steps: Confirm the destination shortcut opens Lossless Scaling while its main window is visible.
Minimize Lossless Scaling to tray and invoke the remapped shortcut several times.
Repeat with Keyboard Manager disabled, using the destination shortcut directly.
Use the same shortcut to activate a simple control application from a minimized state.
reproduce.expected_result: If the shortcut reaches Windows, the target or control application responds; comparison isolates a remap-delivery failure from Lossless Scaling's tray behavior.
